name: Colour Relay
intent: Player sees the water ripple change hue at each tree (cool, warm, gold) while the phrase is re-voiced; learns each tree is a different voice of one song.

relay_timing.note: hue must be read inside the 0.27s pulse window per event

ResonanceSoft.new_cpp: NEW C++: QuantumReactionColor = FindSkill(PendingSkillId)->LaneColor (cpp:380-386); PendingSkillId is NAME_None for direct RequestDraw calls (set only in StartNextSongDraw, cpp:317), so colour cannot be set per response. NEW C++ needed.

audio_cue_intent: Per-tree bell MetaSound with a filter that brightens each hop; the return layers the earlier voices. Descriptive only.
unverified_or_new_cpp: QuantumPulse is set to 1.0 on a successful draw then decays 3.5/s (DrawSubsystem.cpp:388,423), so it stays above the bridge threshold 0.05 (Bridge.h:171) for ~0.27s. QuantumBackend=1 only for non-classical backends (cpp:372-375). QuantumSeed=frac(seed/100000) (cpp:368). QuantumChoice=chart_index/(N-1) only for ids 'chart_N', else 0.0 (cpp:357-366).

QuantumReactionColor = FindSkill(PendingSkillId)->LaneColor (cpp:380-386); PendingSkillId is NAME_None for direct RequestDraw calls (set only in StartNextSongDraw, cpp:317), so colour cannot be set per response. NEW C++ needed.
Semantic ids are not 'chart_N': ChartIndexFromId returns INDEX_NONE and QuantumChoice publishes 0.0 (cpp:28-36,364). Use wire ids chart_0/chart_1/chart_2 (list order) or NEW C++.

Bridge reacts only to water contact events from its owner actor (bOnlySpawnForOwner, Bridge.cpp:138), types SurfaceEntry/Exit/DiveStarted/Splash/WaterImpact (cpp:298-302), max 2/s (Profile.h:162). A tree-located reaction needs a new event emitter; how MelodiaWaterInteractionSubsystem publishes events was NOT read.
RequestDraw returns 'busy' while another draw is in flight (cpp:89-96); gaps must exceed HTTP round trip + QuantumDrawTimeoutMs (config values not read).
Chaos draws are score-WEIGHTED samples (scores are close), so the intensity ordering holds only for the listed seeds.
QuantumBackend=1 for chaos (cpp:372-375) although it is classical code.
Colour-led design is not deliverable without new C++.

parameters.winner_prediction: winner found by searching seeds 1-4999 with the real draw_providers code; weighted sample, reproducible only for this seed
